incidents.name: XSIJ public removePoolAmount()
incidents.notes: XSIJ exposes a permissionless removePoolAmount() that destroys XSIJ held by the XSIJ/BUSD pair, letting the attacker buy first, shrink the pool and sell back at the inflated price.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x31bfA137C76561ef848c2af9Ca301b60451CaAC0 created 2024-01-25T12:33:31Z by 0x09168697cb9bdfce7739f46e152451ef8b2ded4b, which is not the attack-tx sender 0xc4f82210c2952fcec77efe734ab2d9b14e858469; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain).
